about_the_game:
About This Game

The ultra-casual and ultra-soothing "Shepherd Planet" is simply a paradise for farming simulation enthusiasts! On this planet, you can take your flock of sheep for a stroll, let them grow strong and healthy, and then they will magically turn into coins that fly into your pocket. Of course, you can also choose to be a lazy sheep, lying on the grass watching the clouds roll by, counting stars at night, or chasing little rabbits on the prairie, dancing with butterflies...

After selling your sheep, new lambs will take their place. The total number of sheep in your flock is linked to your device's performance—the stronger the performance, the more sheep you can have. But don't worry, the game will automatically adjust to ensure smooth gameplay without any lag.

More new skins are waiting for you to unlock!

Haven't seen your furry friend's image yet? Don't worry, a wave of super cute dog breeds will be unlocked soon!
